description: Use this when the user explicitly authorizes publishing a reviewed existing Postlyra rich draft to a connected Telegram channel. Resolve channelId using list_channels, inspect preview_post, and supply confirmed=true plus confirmationText containing the user's authorization. Reuse idempotencyKey on retry. Queued/retrying means pending, not delivered. This is the external publication action; draft tools never send.

channelId.description: Owner-bound Postlyra channel id or exact channel title returned by list_channels.

name: publish_post
title: Publish a Postlyra post
